scope: 2026 presidential runoff, available AC–RJ; partial national; other elections require explicit imports

source_object.grain: One exact byte sequence; never a URL or a section

storage_locator.meaning: Object location relative to declared source root

source_observation.grain: One attempt to observe an asset URL in one acquisition run

official_url.meaning: Official asset URL even when mirror used

object_sha256.meaning: Received bytes; null on failed/no-body attempt

observed_at.meaning: Client observation time with explicit UTC offset

last_modified_raw.meaning: Original HTTP header; not publication time

observation_status.meaning: success, missing, blocked, failed or historical_mapping_unknown

source_package.grain: One official section/package identity within an election, independent of byte hash

package_observation.grain: One package advertisement in one metadata observation

package_asset.grain: One advertised filename in a package metadata observation

snapshot.grain: One immutable declared input population and selection policy

snapshot_id.meaning: Digest of canonical inventory + policy + schema version

snapshot_observation.grain: One frozen observation included in snapshot

election.grain: One official election and round in its pleito

contest.grain: One cargo/jurisdiction contest in an election

location.grain: One polling location identity scoped to election

municipality_tse.meaning: Zero-padded TSE code, never implicitly IBGE

section.grain: One registered section in election, including member sections

section_composition.grain: One member-to-principal assignment per snapshot; principal maps to itself
rules: Same election for member, principal and location; principal self-map exists; no chains/cycles.
Many members to one principal; this bridge NEVER expands principal results before summation.

candidacy.grain: One official candidacy in one contest

official_candidate_id.meaning: Stable official candidacy identifier, not name

vote_choice.grain: One countable choice/category in one contest

choice_kind.meaning: candidate, blank, null, special or unresolved

rules: Candidate requires candidacy in same contest; all other kinds require null candidacy.

physical_device.grain: One evidenced physical machine, independent of section and package

device_id.meaning: Identity from authoritative serial evidence; never inferred from section

identity_state.meaning: verified or unresolved; unresolved identities never merge by model

configuration_id.meaning: Digest of known configuration fields + unknown markers

result_version.grain: One observed BU/result version for principal section and contest

result_status.meaning: totalized, received, rejected, excluded, unknown or conflict

rules: Section and contest must belong to same election.

section_contest_totals.grain: One totals row per result version, NEVER per candidate

attending_voters.meaning: Official attendance, separate from completed log cycles

special_votes.meaning: Exceptional categories; 0 only if explicitly absent

rules: Nonnegative integers; candidate + blank + applicable null + special + unresolved = total when all meanings resolved.
Electorate and attendance are not additive over vote_choice rows.

vote_choice_count.grain: One count per choice per result version
rules: Result and choice contest must match; completeness ledger distinguishes absent row from explicit zero.

canonical_result.grain: One selection decision per snapshot/principal/contest; conflict never picks arbitrarily

result_version_id.meaning: Selected version only when eligible and conflict resolved

rules: Selected version matches principal/contest; totalized official target phase only; conflicting versions stay unavailable.

voting_session.grain: One reconstructed physical operational session in parser run, not one file

session_kind.meaning: official VOTA, setup, training, other or unresolved

uncertainty.meaning: Ambiguity, missing blocks, clocks and rule evidence

rules: Multiple replacement sessions can serve one principal; deduplicate evidenced overlapping blocks, never message/timestamp alone.

session_package.grain: One session/package evidence link; never a result aggregation path

selected_event.grain: One ordered parsed event, selected or excluded with reason

event_sequence.meaning: Preserved relative sequence, not clock order

anonymous_cycle.grain: One reconstructed anonymous voter cycle; contains NO candidate or RDV link

duration_seconds.meaning: Only comparable clocks within a cycle

coverage_ledger.grain: One expected registered section per snapshot, including missing/excluded cases

log_availability.meaning: available, missing, not_published, not_applicable or unknown

bu_availability.meaning: available, missing, not_published, not_applicable or unknown

record_lineage.grain: One original-record contribution to a derived row; multiple references allowed

record_locator.meaning: Canonical JSON locator: nested archive path segments with member occurrence index, original line/byte/record range where known; original line sequence anchors event identity, never timestamp/message alone

parsing_issue.grain: One retained issue anchored to original bytes

details.meaning: Issue interpretation and uncertainty; minimize selected structured fields, omit voter/mesario identifiers and unnecessary raw sensitive tokens; source bytes remain authoritative

processing_event.grain: One observed lifecycle event or explicit missing event field for a package/result, preserving repeated observations

observation_id.meaning: Original source observation; client observation is not publisher publication

package_id.meaning: Package lifecycle subject; may exist before BU import

result_version_id.meaning: Result subject when available; not required for package events

event_kind.meaning: receipt, processing, generation, publication or observation; never interchangeable

availability_state.meaning: observed, missing_source, not_published, unresolved or conflict

event_sequence.meaning: Original sequence when the source supplies it

rules: At least one package/result subject required; if both present they must agree.
Each event needs original-record lineage. Missing event time requires availability reason; repeated/corrected timestamps append events.
Package events do not depend on a successful BU import. Event omission alone does not establish not-published status.

harmonized_population.grain: One declared disjoint comparison population across explicitly imported election rounds/years

harmonization_policy.meaning: Evidence/rules for compositions, transfers, electorate change and completeness

rules: Do not infer equal electorates from equal section numbers or polling-place names.
Only whole principal units with justified population correspondence may be summed; otherwise incomparable, no invented proportional vote allocation.

harmonized_member.grain: One whole principal result population membership per comparison policy and source election snapshot
rules: Within one harmonization policy, snapshot/principal belongs to at most one population; publication must check disjointness across group IDs.
Aggregate each round separately at common-population grain before joining rounds, never expand one round by all members of another.
